ORDINANCE thmary 11, 2025

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-K in the area bound by:

West Augusta Boulevard; a line 122.3 feet east of and parallel to North Kildare Avenue;
the alley next south of and parallel to West Augusta Boulevard; a line 86.3 feet east of
and parallel to North Kildare Avenue

to those of a RT-3.5, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and due publication.

Common Address: 4249 W. Augusta Blvd.
